name: Roasted Tomato Lentil Soup
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) red lentils, rinsed
3 cups water or low-sodium vegetable stock
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil on a tray and roast for 25 minutes until the edges are charred.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins. Add everything from the tray to a pot with the lentils, cumin, paprika and water.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 12 minutes until the lentils are completely soft.
Blend until smooth, adding hot water if too thick. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve in bowls topped with fresh coriander or basil.
note: High in fibre and plant protein; red lentils thicken the soup without cream.
